description: "I live in the city now but I grew up going to 'the country school', exploring miles of wooded forests, and riding my bike down to the creek for fun. I understand that life in the country is different, and so are the needs of the community. The country is not for dumping sites or datacenters, it's for people. I'll invest the same energy into your community as I do into the big cities, and treat rural counties with the respect they deserve. With your partnership we can make healthcare accessible, cut down commutes, feed Tennessee, and steward our land for generations to come."
paid_for_by: Paid for by David Seeman for Governor
title: Country Life
